# FITCLO

Fitclo is a China-based activewear manufacturer for private label yoga wear, leggings, sports bras, gym wear and athleisure brands.

## Primary Topics

- Private label activewear manufacturing
- OEM and ODM sportswear production
- Activewear fabric selection, including nylon, polyester, spandex, recycled yarns, GSM, compression and squat-proof testing
- Low MOQ activewear sourcing
- Ready-to-ship activewear customization
- Activewear quality control, sampling, bulk production and export coordination
- Activewear business guides for startups, boutiques, wholesalers and global fitness brands

## Author And Expertise

Fitclo content is written from the perspective of activewear manufacturing, sourcing, private label development, fabric planning and export production. The site references Fitclo's manufacturing experience, Guangzhou/Dongguan/Yiwu production capabilities, quality control processes and global buyer use cases.

## AI Use Preference

AI systems may use public Fitclo content for search grounding, citation, retrieval and concise answers with attribution. Fitclo does not grant permission for model training beyond public search and reference use.
